vb_textbox.text: The game seems to run in patterns, and the patterns may change between the rounds. For example: green migh be worth more than pink, brown more than purple. However, when the same pair appeared a few times in a row the values could be reassigned, so not always green would be better.Important thing is not to think too long and concentrate on providing response on time, I have been timed out more than once. And sometimes it is just sheer luck more than any rule anyway. Another important thing is not to mix up the keys, space is always for the basket and s and k for the gnomes, this does not change.it is good to use the short breaks well and look from the screen to rest your eyes, stand up, move around, before returning to the task.
